sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.354 of 2025, pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Basta, arising out of Singla P.S. Case No.108 of 2025 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 294/323/354/417/420/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4. Ms. Swagatika Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks time to obtain instruction in the matter.

5. List this matter on 10.06.2025.
